verdict.rationale: The CDP Facilitator submits settlement onchain and reports the result to the seller's resource server, and sellers can receive funds into Coinbase Business, Prime, CDP custodial, or self-custody wallets. That documents a settlement and payout path, but nothing shows merchant-facing reporting, statements, or reconciliation tooling that would make agent payments reconcilable like other channels. missing for 10: documented merchant reporting/export or reconciliation flows, mapping of onchain settlements to orders or ledgers, payout reports in Coinbase Business, independent or hands-on corroboration of reconciliation.

support.subject: As a merchant, agent-originated payments settle through documented payout and reporting flows, reconcilable like any other channel

citations.quote: it validates signed payments, screens transactions, submits settlement onchain, and reports the result to your resource server
Sellers receive at any address they control — including CDP custodial wallets, Coinbase Business, Prime, or a self-custody wallet
